author: Pallas, 1764
summary: 봄과 가을에 우리나라를 흔히 지나가는 나그네새이며, 일부는 강 하구나 해안에서 겨울을 난다. 해안, 간척지, 삼각주 등에 내려앉는다. 갑각류, 작은 물고기, 조개, 지렁이, 곤충을 잡아먹고 식물 씨앗이나 싹, 이끼, 규조류도 먹는다. 북극 가까운 툰드라와 그린란드에서 번식해 풀이 우거진 땅의 오목한 곳에 알 4개를 낳고, 동남아시아·오스트레일리아·아프리카·남미 등에서 겨울을 난다.

art.subject: Sanderling (Calidris alba), adult in winter (non-breeding) plumage, as seen on Korean sandy shores and river mouths from October to March: very pale silvery-grey upperparts with fine dark shaft streaks and whitish feather edges; a blackish patch at the bend of the wing (lesser coverts) often shows as a dark shoulder; forehead, face and supercilium white with a faint grey eye-stripe; underparts pure white without breast streaks; straight black bill; dark eye; black legs.
art.pose: foraging on wet sand at the water's edge
art.scene: Korean sandy coast near a river mouth in winter, wet sand and shallow water; no people, buildings or text
views: adult winter, side view running on wet sand: palest of the small waders, silvery-grey back, dark shoulder patch at the bend of the wing, white face and pure white underparts, straight black bill and black legs
adult breeding (May), side view standing: head, neck, breast and upperparts rufous-chestnut with black spots and whitish feather fringes, clean white belly sharply set off, black bill and legs
art.build: Small, plump, compact sandpiper, 20cm, about the size of a Dunlin but chunkier, larger than a sparrow; short neck and round head. Bill black, straight, about as long as the head, fairly thick at the base with a blunt tip. Legs black, short to medium; only three forward toes and no hind toe. At rest the wingtips reach about the tail tip. In flight a broad, bold white wing-bar across dark flight feathers and coverts, a dark leading edge to the wing, and a rump and tail with a dark centre and white sides. Runs very fast after retreating waves like a clockwork toy.
avoid: Do not droop the bill tip (Dunlin); the Sanderling's bill is straight.
Do not paint a grey-brown streaked breast on the winter bird; it is pure white below.
Do not paint yellow or greenish legs, or a hind toe.
Do not paint rufous breeding colours on the bird in the winter scene.
